comment: Swift standard-library conformance facts the generator cannot recover from a local TypeDecl (the stdlib has no TypeDecl in the corpus). ONE input to ConformanceOracle, not the whole base: foreign cross-module conformances resolve via ABI-confirmed specialization hints and transitive refinement, not this table. Deliberately MINIMAL — a curated slice that omits true-but-irrelevant conformances (Sendable/Copyable/Decodable/...). Verify against the live toolchain with `nuke regen-stdlib-conformances`, which dumps the Swift stdlib via swift-api-digester and PRUNES any entry the live stdlib no longer declares but never widens the set; to add a type or protocol, edit here then re-run regen to confirm it against ground truth. Bump schemaVersion here AND ConformanceOracle.ExpectedStdlibSchemaVersion in lockstep on any shape change.
